author: reyesthighs
content: Chat I am thinking about moving my cats into the apartment with me

author: reyesthighs
content: I am very worried about this. I own two cats, and there are already two cats in the apartment. However, my cats are struggling with the addition of a puppy to the house; Nguyen. Nguyen is about 9ish months now and in obedience training, but she is a terrier mix with a high prey drive. She has never attacked the cats, but she cries when anyone plays with the cats and barks/gets upset when she sees them.

author: reyesthighs
content: Nguyen is my mothers dog, and I feel bad because A. My mom has been taking care of, feeding, and doing the litter for *my* cats who are *my* responsibility. And B. if we couldn't keep Nguyen she would have to go back to the shelter, where she would go back on the euthanasia list. She is a good dog and she doesn't deserve that, and we knew there was a possibility that they may not work well together from the start. I imagine that, with another month or two of obedience training and just being around cats for the first time in her life, she could learn to tolerate them like all of our other dogs have.
